text:
Maya: quick sync — i want to run a tightly scoped experiment for the pricing page next week. target: reduce inbound handoffs and improve self-serve conversions for mid-market. idea = small FAQ rewrite + tier name adjustments + microcalculator copy variants. thoughts?

Alejandro: love it. do we have a hypothesis and primary metric? conversions -> request demo vs signups?

Maya: primary metric = try-to-convert rate on pricing (clicks on Start trial / Contact sales). secondary = demo leads quality (MQL score). hypothesis: clearer tier names + simpler FAQ will shift ~5% of demo-intent to self-serve.

Samir: can we scope the calculator change to just the copy and default assumptions? keep logic identical. two variants: baseline vs conversational copy. i can ship quick A/B flags. :thumbsup:

Kate: suggestion: also test a short one-line nudges under the CTA: "Estimate monthly cost in 30s" vs "See commitment options and discounts" — different conversational framing.

Maya: yes. we should only run 2x2 (tier-name + calculator copy) to keep power ok. Kate — can you draft the two CTA nudge lines?

Kate: will do, sending drafts by EOD.

Alejandro: for tier names I propose: "Starter | Developer | Production" (baseline) vs "Launch | Scale | Enterprise" (variant). keep the short descriptors underneath. comments?

Marcus: "Launch / Scale" feels less enterprise-y than Developer/Production. sales worry: Enterprise buyers might get confused about whether 'Enterprise' is our top tier. maybe keep "Enterprise" as top in the variant: "Launch | Scale | Enterprise" — fine. also ask: will pricing ranges remain the same?

Maya: no price changes, only naming + microcopy. we'll surface price bands like today. Marcus: can you confirm which segments to route to CDP when someone selects "Contact sales"? need to ensure demo routing doesn't break.

Marcus: confirmed — no change to routing. I'll add a tag `pricing_experiment_march26` on demo leads so we can filter.

Emily: legal quick note: avoid language like "cheapest in class" or any absolute claims. also if we show estimated savings (calc), add the caveat: "Actual costs may vary; estimates exclude infra and third-party fees." I can sign off on the FAQ copy if you tag me.

Maya: thanks — will add your caveat. Olivia — can you upload a Figma with the exact microcopy placements?

Olivia: uploading now: https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/pricing-microtest — added frames for CTA nudge, calculator modal, and FAQ accordion.

Samir: tracking: i'm going to instrument event `pricing_calc_open` and `pricing_calc_submit_variant` + `pricing_cta_click`. will add experiment flags `tierVariantA` and `calcCopyB`.

Maya: timeline: design + legal signoff by Thu, dev flag + QA Fri, rollout Mon (50% traffic variant) for 2 weeks. measurements: % click Start trial, % contact sales, demo MQL rate, avg session time on pricing.

Alejandro: for reporting, can we get quick bench of current week vs experiment? i'll own dashboard. pls push events to Amplitude with those tags.

Marcus: FYI i'll prep a short email to AE team previewing the change so they don't freak out when tier names swap.

Kate: drafting webinar blurb that references the new "Scale" messaging — could be used as a follow-up nurture for signups who used calc.

Emily: reviewed FAQ copy — minor tweak: change "you'll save" -> "estimated savings". tagged in comments. :eyes:

Olivia: updated Figma with Emily's edits and added small-screen variants.

Samir: QA checklist for dev: 1) flag toggles 2) event firing 3) calculator math unchanged 4) accessibility check on accordion. posted snippet:

```
// example flag
experimentFlags = { tierVariant: 'B', calcCopyVariant: 'A' }
```

Maya: action items: Kate (CTA lines + webinar blurb) — due EOD. Alejandro (dashboard) — Monday morning. Samir (flags + events) — Fri. Emily (legal signoff) — Thu. Marcus (AE note + routing tag) — Fri. Olivia (Figma final) — Thu. i'll schedule a 15m test-run on Fri. :spiral_calendar: 

Alejandro: sounds good. one more ask — can we add a tiny survey after calc submit: 1 question "Did this estimate help you decide? (Yes / No)" to capture intent. short lived.

Maya: good idea. Samir — can you add the event and small modal?

Samir: yep, adding `pricing_calc_feedback` with values yes/no.

Maya: perfect. thanks team — i'll post a recap in #marketing after legal signoff and before rollout. :rocket:
